issues.reason: Time states that time atoms "go inside the strength-0 `(And …)` of a negated event like any other conjunct" and the worked example "Bob didn't cook dinner" carries `(Past sk_cook_1)` inside the bundle, so the past-marked "was unable" must have `(Past sk_reach_1)` inside; without it the denial reads as a present/unmarked inability.

Core patterns bars adding a relation world knowledge supplies ("point at the words that put the atom there") — "the Adrian McPherson gambling trial" states an association, not that he is the party tried, so `Theme` (the evaluated object) asserts more than the text states.

gaps_confirmed: proper noun as a prenominal modifier naming a participant of an event noun ("the Adrian McPherson gambling trial") — Compound concepts excludes proper nouns, and Possessive/genitive NP covers only 's, possessive pronouns and of-phrases, so no head is specified for the link

an "after" clause whose subordinate eventuality is denied — the `Before` relation's only endpoint is an event the parse asserts at strength 0, and nothing licenses reifying the inability itself as the anchor

negative lexical modal "was unable to V" — Negation (copular) makes un- antonyms positive properties while the "Bob can't cook" pattern maps inability to a strength-0 `(Can e)` bundle, and which governs is unstated
repair_summary: Added `(Past sk_reach_1)` inside the strength-0 inability bundle; removed `(Theme sk_trial_1 adrian_mcpherson)` — the prenominal-name link has no licensed head, so the offending content is dropped rather than replaced.
notes: `(Name adrian_mcpherson "Adrian McPherson")` is kept: the name is stated by the text and the atom is true, even with no licensed relation to the trial. The title in the Name string, the framing `In` oblique, the bare deictic `today`, the `gambling_trial` genus, the indefinite verdict kept inside the denial and the "after" argument swap all stand.
